post.description: The endpoint an SMS gateway calls for each message it receives.

One step of one inbound call, as the voice provider's webhook reports it.

Off unless `voice_gateway_key` is set, which it is not by default: no
provider has been chosen, and an endpoint that stores patient data
must not be reachable because a setting was left at a placeholder.

The provider's own payload is mapped onto `VoiceStep` by an adapter,
so nothing in the record depends on which company carries the call.

get.description:

second worker, the database does.

AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest
AnswerRequest.description: An answer is words, a tap, a recording, or a tap with a recording.

AppChecklistItem.title: AppChecklistItem
AppChecklistItem.description: Exactly as printed on the activated prescription.

AppDocument.title: AppDocument
AppDocument.description: One page the patient sent or the clinic scanned, and what was read off it.

AppDocumentAdvice.title: AppDocumentAdvice
AppDocumentAdvice.description: What the prescription asks for that is not a medicine, as written.

AppDocumentLine.title: AppDocumentLine
AppDocumentLine.description: A medicine as read off the patient's own page, exactly as written.

AppDocumentValue.title: AppDocumentValue
AppDocumentValue.description:
A laboratory value off the patient's own page.

`value_text` is null until the value is renderable. `proj.renderable_value`
admits only accepted and confirmed values, and it is the only view a value
may be read from, so a number nobody has settled has no text to show.

AppMeal.title: AppMeal
AppMeal.description: A meal photograph: which meal, when it was taken, and calories only if typed.

AppRecording.title: AppRecording
AppRecording.description: A recording kept at the clinic, to attach to an answer.

AppUploadStatus.title: AppUploadStatus
AppUploadStatus.description: Where a page the patient sent has got to. The phone polls this.

Box.title: Box
Box.description: Normalised 0..1 region on the page, as core.provenance stores it.

ChainCheck.title: ChainCheck
ChainCheck.description: The result of recomputing every hash in audit.event, oldest first.

ComplianceScore.title: ComplianceScore
ComplianceScore.description:
The one approved score. Computed from medication ticks only, shown to
clinicians only, and always sent with the day array it came from, so
the page can recount it.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description:
What a reviewer decided about one item.

decision_latency_ms runs from the moment the crop finished rendering to
the decision. The client cannot send a decision before that moment.

InboundSms.title: InboundSms
InboundSms.description: One message as the gateway received it. The body is never stored, only its hash.

ItemDecision.title: ItemDecision
ItemDecision.description:
A reviewer's confirmation of one line. The text fields are present only
when the reviewer corrected what was read; the original stays in the
audit log.

PaperFormSubmission.title: PaperFormSubmission
PaperFormSubmission.description: A week of a paper form, transcribed by clinic staff, stored as written.

PatientListItem.title: PatientListItem
PatientListItem.description:
One row of the patient list: who the patient is, and what the record
holds now. Counts and dates of the record only, never a judgement.

QueueItem.title: QueueItem
QueueItem.description: One open item. The value is shown as read, next to the crop it came from.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The check that sent these values to a person

ReadLine.title: ReadLine
ReadLine.description: One line of a handwritten prescription. Every line goes to a person.

RecordValue.title: RecordValue
RecordValue.description: A renderable value, exactly as printed. Nothing derived is attached.

RegimenAdvice.title: RegimenAdvice
RegimenAdvice.description: An instruction that is not a medicine. Never counted as a dose.

SignedIn.title: SignedIn
SignedIn.description: A token for this phone, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and whose it is.

SurveyForm.title: SurveyForm
SurveyForm.description: A paper survey photographed at the desk. Kept as it is, never read.

TraceHistory.title: TraceHistory
TraceHistory.description:
How the value reached the record. 'accepted' means every check passed
and no person was involved; the other two name the person.

values_in_record.title: Values In Record
values_in_record.description: Values that passed every check and are in the record

sent_to_queue.title: Sent To Queue
sent_to_queue.description: Values waiting for a person, by reason

regimen_id.title: Regimen Id
regimen_id.description: For a prescription: the regimen this document produced

lines_accepted.title: Lines Accepted
lines_accepted.description: Prescription lines every check passed, settled without a person

lines_for_a_person.title: Lines For A Person
lines_for_a_person.description: Prescription lines a clinician still has to confirm

VoiceReply.title: VoiceReply
VoiceReply.description:
What the call should do next. No prompt text, only which prompt.

The audio is recorded by people in each language and played by the
adapter, so nothing here is spoken by a machine and no drug name is
ever read out: a medicine is its number on the patient's SMS card.

call_id.title: Call Id
call_id.description: The provider's id for this call

VoiceStep.title: VoiceStep
VoiceStep.description:
One step of one inbound call, as the provider's webhook reports it.

Deliberately not any provider's own shape: an adapter maps Twilio's or
Exotel's form fields onto this, so the record never depends on which
company carries the call.

Waiting.title: Waiting
Waiting.description: What still needs a person before it can be shown or ticked.
